Subject: Cascade 45L is back in stock
Preview: Your pack is ready when your next trip is.
Body: If you've been waiting on the Northbay Cascade 45L, it's back.

Here's what it carries: 45 liters of gear, organized the way a multi-day trip actually works. The internal frame keeps the load close to your back without adding bulk — the whole pack weighs 1.4 kg.

The shell is ripstop nylon with water resistance built in. It'll handle rain and trail spray. It is not waterproof, so if you're heading into sustained downpour territory, pack a liner for anything critical.

That's the pack. If it fits your next trip, now's the time to grab one.
